Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet, c As PivotCache, p As PivotTable, f As PivotField
Set ws=Worksheets(1)
ws.Range("A1:B1").Value=Array("Region","Amount")
ws.Range("A2:B2").Value=Array("East",10)
ws.Range("A3:B3").Value=Array("West",20)
ws.Range("A4:B4").Value=Array("East",30)
ws.Range("A5:B5").Value=Array("West",40)
ws.Range("A6:B6").Value=Array("East",50)
On Error GoTo Failed
Set c=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,ws.Range("A1:B6"))
Probe=State(c)
Set p=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E3"),"Made")
Probe=Probe & "|after:" & State(c) & "|tables:" & CStr(ws.PivotTables.Count) & "|name:" & p.Name & "|range:" & p.TableRange1.Address & "|body:" & p.DataBodyRange.Address
For Each f In p.PivotFields
Probe=Probe & "|field:" & f.Name
Next
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe=Probe & "|ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|caches:" & CStr(ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Count)
End Function
Private Function State(c As PivotCache) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
State="count=" & CStr(ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Count) & ",records=" & CStr(c.RecordCount) & ",version=" & CStr(c.Version) & ",index=" & CStr(c.Index)
Exit Function
Failed:
State=State & ",ERR=" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function

Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet, c As PivotCache, p As PivotTable, f As PivotField
Set ws=Worksheets(1)
ws.Range("A1:B1").Value=Array("Region","Amount")
ws.Range("A2:B2").Value=Array("East",10)
ws.Range("A3:B3").Value=Array("West",20)
ws.Range("A4:B4").Value=Array("East",30)
ws.Range("A5:B5").Value=Array("West",40)
ws.Range("A6:B6").Value=Array("East",50)
On Error GoTo Failed
ThisWorkbook.Names.Add "DataSource","=Sheet1!$A$1:$B$6"
Set c=ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase,"DataSource")
Probe=CStr(c.SourceData)
Set p=c.CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("E3"),"Made")
Probe=Probe & "|" & p.TableRange1.Address & "|" & p.PivotFields(1).Name & "|" & CStr(ws.Range("F3:G3").MergeCells) & "|records:" & CStr(c.RecordCount) & "|after:" & CStr(c.SourceData)
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe=Probe & "|ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & "|caches:" & CStr(ThisWorkbook.PivotCaches.Count) & "|tables:" & CStr(ws.PivotTables.Count)
End Function
